web:panasonic-poscap-precautions.item: GR-ZONE2-SMD POSCAP usage conditions (rush current, failure mode)
web:panasonic-poscap-precautions.method: curl (default User-Agent); redirected to https://industrial.panasonic.com/cdbs/www-data/pdf/ABE0000/ast-ind-176393.pdf (23831653 bytes), text via PyMuPDF; the cited pages rendered with PyMuPDF and read from the images
web:panasonic-poscap-precautions.title: Matters to Be Observed When Using This Product (POSCAP), printed pages 48-49 (PDF pages 51-52), dated 20-Aug-25
web:panasonic-poscap-precautions.note: Page 49: an excessively large rush current from rapid charge/discharge may cause a short circuit or a leakage increase; when a rush current exceeds 20 A, apply a protective circuit. Keep ripple so that the case top stays within the rated temperature (for TQC contact Panasonic separately). Page 48: random failures are mainly short mode (thermal, electrical or mechanical stress); wear-out failures end in an open mode. Moisture: floor life level 3 = 168 h at 30 C / 60 %RH after opening the bag.
